# .github

GitHub-specific configuration for the anokye-labs/plugins repository.

## Contents

| Directory / File | Purpose |
|------------------|---------|
| `workflows/` | GitHub Actions CI/CD workflows (validation, e2e, triage, auto-approve) |
| `plugin/` | Marketplace registry (`marketplace.json`) |
| `ISSUE_TEMPLATE/` | Issue templates (bug report, feature request, task) |
| `agents/` | Agentic workflow agent definitions |
| `aw/` | Additional workflow configuration |
| `copilot-instructions.md` | Repository-level Copilot instructions |
